title: Seller month in the seller's own time zone
desc: The seller goal and its forecast count the month in the Market's zone, because the rollups are by Market day (ADR-0005 prefers the owning party's zone). Counting it in the seller's zone needs a data step first: reporting must keep seller-zone days (or instants) for the sales, and the stored goals' `month` (a Market-zone month) must be mapped or re-keyed to the seller's zone.
src: Dashboards v2 phase 2, monthly targets PR
trig: A Market spans more than one time zone with sellers in several of them
